name: How do one-bedroom ADU floor plans differ from studio ADU floor plans?

mainEntity.name: How do one-bedroom ADU floor plans differ from studio ADU floor plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: One-bedroom ADU floor plans include a separate, enclosed bedroom, offering more privacy and a distinct sleeping area. Studio ADU floor plans, conversely, combine the sleeping, living, and kitchen areas into a single open space, often with a separate bathroom. Studios are generally more compact and cost-effective to build, making them suitable for smaller lots or tighter budgets. One-bedroom units provide more defined living zones and can be preferable for longer-term rentals or family members needing more personal space.
acceptedAnswer.description: One-bedroom ADUs have a separate bedroom for privacy, while studio ADUs combine living spaces into one open room. Studios are typically more compact.
